mcp_tools.name: fszero.exec
mcp_tools.description: Execute one FSZero single-letter opcode. Map: L=ls R=read S=search E=edit C=compound X=expand W=world (NOT write) T=stat V=resolve P=write/put H=history U=undo M=memory. Agents often guess W for write — use P.

mcp_tools.name: fszero.ls
mcp_tools.description: List files; supports --depth, --budget, glob

mcp_tools.name: fszero.read
mcp_tools.description: Read file or byte range path#Bstart-end

mcp_tools.name: fszero.search
mcp_tools.description: Search files or structural queries (callers:, defs:)

mcp_tools.name: fszero.edit
mcp_tools.description: Guarded edit path:old|new

mcp_tools.name: fszero.write
mcp_tools.description: Create-or-overwrite file: path|content (parents created, root-guarded)

mcp_tools.name: fszero.expand
mcp_tools.description: Expand ref or recovery key (harness/UI)

mcp_tools.name: fszero.world
mcp_tools.description: Speculative worlds: fork | new:/newbatch: | edit:<wid>:<spec> | view:<wid>[:<path>] overlay reads | conflicts:<wid> live hunk overlaps | commit:<wid> three-way merge (:git exports a git commit) | drop:<wid>

mcp_tools.name: fszero.history
mcp_tools.description: Mutation timeline: path, path|N, |N, or empty (newest first; full JSON behind ref)

mcp_tools.name: fszero.undo
mcp_tools.description: Revert a journaled mutation: path (latest) or path|seq; preimage-guarded

mcp_tools.name: fszero.world_query
mcp_tools.description: Access ledger: hot, recent, or coaccess paths

mcp_tools.name: fszero.resolve
mcp_tools.description: Intent resolution — ranked fz://blob refs (no file bodies)

mcp_tools.name: fszero.stat
mcp_tools.description: Stat metadata behind refs

mcp_tools.name: fszero.memory_put
mcp_tools.description: Durable agent memory write (mem://). Returns ~1-token ack + fz://blob ref; bytes stay server-side until expand.

mcp_tools.name: fszero.memory_get
mcp_tools.description: Durable agent memory read. Ack + fz://blob ref; harness expands exact bytes on demand.

mcp_tools.name: fszero.memory_ls
mcp_tools.description: List durable memory paths under an optional prefix (default: all mem://).

mcp_tools.name: fszero.memory_delete
mcp_tools.description: Delete a durable memory path (mem://).

mcp_tools.name: fszero.memory_rename
mcp_tools.description: Rename a durable memory path (mem://).

mcp_tools.name: fszero.multi_read
mcp_tools.description: Vectorized snapshot-consistent file reads with ordered per-item results

mcp_tools.name: fszero.multi_search
mcp_tools.description: Vectorized multi-query search with one shared indexed traversal

mcp_tools.name: fszero.multi_stat
mcp_tools.description: Vectorized metadata lookup with ordered per-item results

mcp_tools.name: fszero.multi_list
mcp_tools.description: Vectorized directory listings with ordered per-item results

codemode_tools.name: fz_execute_code
codemode_tools.description: Execute an FSZero CodeMode plan server-side (recipe, JSON, or sandboxed JavaScript).

codemode_tools.name: fz_codemode_search
codemode_tools.description: Progressive API discovery — ranked fs.* methods and intent recipes

codemode_tools.name: fz_codemode_describe
codemode_tools.description: Describe a CodeMode method or capabilities manifest
